name: p01b_pillow
prompt: Strict first-person point of view, the camera is the viewer's eyes, head resting sideways on a white pillow in a dark bedroom at 1 a.m.: in the near foreground the viewer's own hand and wrist in a charcoal hoodie sleeve hold a glowing smartphone, cool blue light on the pillow and duvet; in the background a tall window streaming with rain and blurred orange city lights. The frame is tilted as if lying down. No person visible, no head, no face, only one hand. 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain.
